purpose: Close the April recovery curve into the existing 30-Apr authority while explicitly charging training attrition and representing lower-net-loss/cadre-return gains as reserve depth and repeat-sortie resilience rather than impossible deck overfill.

four_core.qualitative: A- to A for one-cycle four-deck coordination. Repeat-cycle endurance is materially better than historical 1944 Japan but still constrained by attack-leader/observer depth and fatigue.

training_cost_16_30Apr.note: Netted into the readiness curve; no free training.

regen_effect: Raw embarked count is now close to deck/airframe ceiling. The branch advantage increasingly appears in spare qualified crews, faster replacement absorption, lower lower-tail squadron weakness and the ability to rebuild after a limited loss without collapsing the whole air group.
guard: Do not exceed the authoritative 30-Apr four-core 280-300 ready band without reopening deck/airframe capacity.
